title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Sentinel's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the civilian refuge record; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
